title: 义务教育教科书·英语（PEP）三年级下册

units.title: Unit 1
units.theme: 认识新朋友 · 你从哪里来
units.themeEn: New friends, where are you from

senses.cnFull: 用于男子的姓或姓名前

sentences.en: Where are you from?
I am from China.

sentences.cn: 他来自英国，她来自加拿大。
sentences.en: He is from the UK and she is from Canada.
Is he from the USA?

sentences.cn: 这是李老师，我们的英语老师。
sentences.en: This is Mr Li, our English teacher.

sentences.cn: 她是我们班新来的学生。
sentences.en: She is a new student in our class.
Who is that girl?

sentences.cn: 那个男孩是我的同班同学。
sentences.en: That boy is my classmate.

sentences.cn: 那位女士和那位先生是我的邻居。
sentences.en: The woman and the man are my neighbours.
We have an English class today.
The teacher is very nice.
We play games after school.
It is about five o'clock.
The rabbit has a short tail.

sentences.cn: 大象有长长的身体和长长的鼻子。
sentences.en: An elephant has a long body and a long nose.
My dog has short legs and a fat body.
The turtle is slow but the rabbit is fast.
You are right.
The cat is thin and the pig is fat.
I love my family.

sentences.cn: 她的礼物是一幅画和一张卡片。
sentences.en: Her gift is a picture and a card.
She can sing and dance.
Wash your face, please.
That is all for today.
The baby is so cute.
Let's talk about the song.
Do you like tea or juice?
Thank you very much.
Bye, see you tomorrow.
I can find my eraser.

sentences.cn: 这是我的尺子，这是我的钢笔。
sentences.en: This is my ruler and this is my pen.
My pencil is in the pencil box.
Open your book and take out a piece of paper.
My bag is on the desk.
These are my new books.
I see a bird in the tree.
I can smell the flowers.
Taste the apple, please.
Can you hear me?
Touch your nose with your finger.
We have five senses.
Put out your tongue and let me see.

sentences.cn: 我们在课堂上学习英语。
sentences.en: We learn English in class.
The computer is on the desk.
It is time for breakfast.
I have bread, an egg and milk.
I like noodles and rice.
Would you like some juice?
The meat is on the plate.
Eat more vegetables.
This soup is yummy.

sentences.cn: 水果对我们来说很健康。
sentences.en: Fruit is healthy for us.
My plate is colourful.
Too much candy is not good.
I am at home now.
Look at my toy boat.
Your new car is cool.
I keep my dolls on the shelf.
The shelves are in my room.
The ball is in the box.
My cap is under the desk.
The map is on the wall.
Put your books on the shelf, please.

sentences.cn: 你的玩具车还在这儿吗？
sentences.en: Is your toy car still here?
There are twelve months in a year.

sentences.cn: 我有十一支铅笔和十三本书。
sentences.en: I have eleven pencils and thirteen books.

sentences.cn: 有十四个男孩和十五个女孩。
sentences.en: There are fourteen boys and fifteen girls.

sentences.cn: 有十六个苹果和十七个梨。
sentences.en: There are sixteen apples and seventeen pears.

sentences.cn: 十八和十九都是很大的数。
sentences.en: Eighteen and nineteen are big numbers.
There are twenty students in my class.
You can choose one toy.
I save my money in a piggy bank.
Don't spend all your money.
Dad, can I pay for it?
Put the book back on the shelf.
